text:
<CAPTION>
A stylized anthropomorphic animal head with a white muzzle, dark brown shaggy hair, and a pink nose, wearing a dark gray knit beanie with two small black ear-like protrusions on top and a square patch with a white logo on the front; the eyes are half-lidded with dark irises and white sclera, and the mouth is slightly open showing teeth; the background is a solid matte beige; the composition is a close-up centered on the head, with the beanie casting a soft shadow on the forehead; the lighting is even and diffused, highlighting the texture of the hair and the knit fabric of the beanie; the patch on the beanie contains a white graphic resembling a stylized animal or symbol.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A stylized anthropomorphic animal with grey fur, black spiky hair, and large pointed ears wears a dark blue knit beanie with a black rectangular patch featuring a white graphic. The creature’s face is partially obscured by shadow, revealing glowing pink eyes, a pink nose, and a pink tongue sticking out slightly. The beanie’s fabric appears textured and matte, while the fur has a soft, slightly matted texture. The background is a gradient of deep purple to magenta, creating a neon-lit effect that casts a pinkish glow along the edges of the subject’s hair and ears. The composition is a tight close-up, centered on the face, with the camera angled slightly upward. The lighting is dramatic, with high contrast between the dark tones of the fur and beanie and the bright pink highlights. A small signature in white script is visible on the right side of the beanie, reading “Zeno”.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A white-furred anthropomorphic rodent with large, pointed ears and a long, thin tail, wearing a tattered, beige hooded cloak with dark brown stains and a green gemstone brooch, has curved, dark brown horns and goggles with glowing green lenses perched on its head. Its face is expressive with a wide, toothy grin, green eyes with long lashes, and a single droplet of sweat on its cheek. Behind it, several shadowy, hooded figures with glowing green eyes and horned heads loom in the dark background. The background is a deep black void with faint specks of light, suggesting a starry night or space. The composition is a medium close-up, angled slightly from the side, focusing on the rodent’s face and upper torso. The lighting is dramatic, with highlights on the rodent’s face and cloak, casting shadows that emphasize its features and the texture of the worn fabric. No visible text is present.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A muscular anthropomorphic wolf character in a red, flowing hooded cloak with a matte fabric texture, standing in a full-body pose; the cloak’s edges are frayed and the hood covers the head, revealing pointed ears and a snout with a glossy black nose and white muzzle. The character wears a black tactical vest over a black armored torso with a matte finish, paired with gray tactical pants with black belts and pouches, and black combat boots with a glossy surface. The background contains multiple line art sketches and color studies of the same character from various angles, including front, back, and side views, showing different poses and expressions. A black-and-white sketch depicts the character in a loose white robe with a matte texture, while other sketches show variations like a red hooded version and a more armored design. The composition is a flat, horizontal layout with the main character on the left, surrounded by smaller sketches and notes in Chinese characters, including "HALLOWEEN" in bold black text inside a black box. The lighting is even and studio-like, highlighting the textures of the clothing and the character’s musculature. Visible text includes "ARKINCHT M4Z" in black, "ガンゾフス" in black, and "@Amzrgnoz" in black at the bottom left corner.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A humanoid figure with dark, spiky hair and pointed ears sits hunched on the ground, their body angled downward with one hand resting on their knee and the other near their chest; their skin appears matte and textured, glowing with a cyan-blue hue under the ambient light, while their hair and the surrounding environment are rendered in deep purples and magentas. The background is a swirling vortex of dark blue and magenta streaks, suggesting motion or a tunnel-like space, with the ground beneath the figure composed of jagged, magenta lines that resemble rough, fibrous material. The composition is centered on the figure, viewed from a slightly low angle that emphasizes their crouched posture and the swirling motion behind them. The lighting is dramatic and stylized, casting sharp contrasts between the glowing cyan-blue skin and the deep, saturated purples and blues of the background, creating a neon-like effect. There is no visible text in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A young female anime character with long, flowing silver hair and soft, fluffy white ears, her face partially obscured as she rests her chin on her hand. Her eyes are large and pink with a glossy, reflective surface, and her cheeks are flushed with a soft pink hue. She wears a black outfit with a high collar and decorative white flowers pinned to her hair and clothing, the fabric appearing smooth and slightly glossy. The background is a deep, star-speckled night sky with gradients of dark purple and black, suggesting a celestial or dreamlike setting. The composition is a close-up, centered on her face, with her gaze directed slightly off-camera, creating an intimate and contemplative mood. The lighting is soft and diffused, highlighting the smooth texture of her skin and the silky sheen of her hair. There is no visible text in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A fox-like humanoid with grey and white fur, wearing a white cloth garment with red straps and a red corded collar, sits cross-legged on green grass beneath a cherry blossom tree, playing a dark wooden flute. The creature’s eyes are closed, and its head is tilted slightly upward as it plays, with its long, bushy tail curled beside it. The tree trunk is dark brown and textured, with pink blossoms falling around it, and the sky behind is a gradient of soft pink and pale blue. The camera is positioned at a low angle, looking up at the figure against the sky, with the tree trunk framing the left side of the composition. The lighting is warm and golden, casting a soft glow on the figure’s fur and clothing, and illuminating the falling petals with a gentle radiance. The grass is green with small pink flowers, and the flute has a matte finish. There is no visible text in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A white-furred anthropomorphic fox with long, flowing white hair and pointed ears lies on a bed of fluffy white pillows, her body arched and partially covered by a large, fluffy white tail. Her skin is glossy white with intricate golden markings that resemble swirling patterns and symbols, and her exposed skin glistens with moisture. She wears a golden crown with pointed tips, and her eyes are half-closed with a relaxed expression. Dark, gloved hands with golden symbols on them are visible, one gripping her hip and another near her lower body. The background is dark and shadowy, contrasting with the bright white fur and pillows. The lighting is soft and focused on the central figure, highlighting the glossy texture of her skin and the fluffy white fur. There is no visible text in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A close-up portrait of an anthropomorphic canine with a white, fluffy face and a glossy black nose, featuring striking orange eyes with black pupils and thick, dark, arched eyebrows. The creature has vibrant magenta hair styled in a spiky, tousled mohawk that contrasts with the white fur on its head and ears, which have black tips. The background is a solid, saturated red with subtle texture, creating a bold contrast with the subject. The composition is centered on the face, shot from a straight-on angle that emphasizes the intense gaze. The lighting is direct and even, highlighting the glossy sheen on the nose and the matte texture of the fur. There is no visible text in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A light blue, fluffy feline creature with large, dark eyes and a small, orange tongue sticking out wears a brown, stitched cowboy hat with a metallic badge on its band; its fur appears soft and matte, and it stands upright with one paw raised near its face against a backdrop of rolling hills and a sky transitioning from warm orange near the horizon to cool blue above, dotted with sparse white clouds; the foreground shows dark brown grass blades, and the distant hills are rendered in muted earth tones with sparse vegetation; the lighting suggests late afternoon or early evening, casting soft shadows and highlighting the creature’s fur with a gentle glow; no text is visible.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A cartoon-style white cat with large pointed ears, pink inner ear linings, and a small pink nose peeks over the peak of a rocky mountain, its paws resting on the edge and its tail curled behind. The cat has a smug expression with half-closed eyes and a small open mouth showing a pink tongue. The background features a light blue sky with scattered white clouds and a distant horizon line. The mountain is composed of grey, textured rock with vertical striations and patches of green coniferous trees clinging to its slopes. The lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows that define the mountain’s contours. The overall composition is centered on the cat, viewed from a low angle looking up, emphasizing its dominance over the landscape. No text is visible.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A stylized white feline creature with large, dark, glossy eyes and a small, curved smile occupies the center of the frame. Its ears are pointed and light beige on the inside, edged with fine, dark brown hair-like strokes. The creature raises its right paw, index finger extended upward, against a brown background patterned with light beige, leafy branches. The feline’s fur is depicted as soft and fluffy, with subtle beige shading on its chest and limbs, and its neck bears a thin, matte beige collar. The background is a solid, matte brown surface, overlaid with repeating light beige leaf motifs that appear to be printed or painted. The composition is a direct, frontal portrait, with the creature centered and looking slightly down at the viewer. The lighting is even and diffused, casting no strong shadows, highlighting the matte texture of the fur and the glossy sheen of the eyes. No text is visible in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A female anthropomorphic fox with long, flowing orange hair and pointed ears sits on a light-colored wooden surface, her body angled slightly toward the viewer. She wears a red, long-sleeved jacket with a dark inner lining, partially open to reveal a dark brown, form-fitting top and black shorts with orange fur trim. Her legs are covered in black thigh-high stockings, and her tail, fluffy and orange with a white tip, curls behind her. She holds a small, wrapped gift with a yellow ribbon in her right hand, while her left hand rests on the wooden surface. Her blue eyes gaze forward with a gentle expression, and her face features a small, curved smile. The background is a plain, bright white, emphasizing the subject. The lighting is soft and even, casting subtle shadows that define her form. The wooden surface has a matte finish, and the fabric of her clothing appears smooth and slightly glossy. There is no visible text in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
Two anthropomorphic female figures with fox ears and tails are embracing in a close, affectionate pose against a bright blue sky with soft white clouds. The foreground figure has long, flowing orange hair with subtle purple highlights, large blue eyes, and wears a black and orange outfit with black thigh-high stockings and a black choker; her ears have small silver piercings and her tail is fluffy and orange with white tips. The second figure, seen mostly from the back, has long blonde hair tied in a braid with a dark red ribbon, and wears a light beige top and dark shorts; her ears are white and pointed. They are positioned on a light brown wooden surface, possibly a deck or pier, with the horizon line suggesting a beach or waterfront. The lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows and highlighting the glossy sheen of their skin and the matte texture of their clothing. There is no visible text or watermark in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A large, stylized whale with a matte, layered gray body and a glossy, curved dorsal fin swims upward through a cosmic scene, its form composed of stacked paper-like layers. Behind it, a massive, textured moon with a matte, orange-yellow surface and irregular, crater-like cutouts glows warmly, partially obscured by wispy, matte gray clouds. The background is a deep, star-speckled black void, dotted with small, orange-red stars and several planets of varying sizes and colors—some with matte brown and orange stripes, others with glossy blue or gray surfaces. Below the whale, a vibrant, layered ocean of translucent teal, orange, and red waves flows, containing smaller, glossy blue fish and floating spheres of various colors. The entire composition is framed by a jagged, dark gray border, giving the impression of a cut-out paper collage with visible creases and shadows, illuminated by a soft, ambient glow that highlights the layered textures and creates a sense of depth. No text is visible.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A canine-like anthropomorphic figure with white and grey fur, glowing amber eyes, and pointed ears, wears a glossy black hooded jacket with a yellow inner lining and a yellow emblem on the sleeve. Rain streaks down vertically across the frame, reflecting off the wet, glossy surface of the jacket and the figure’s fur, which appears fluffy and damp. The background is a muted grey sky with dark clouds, and sparse, blurred vegetation is visible at the bottom edge. The camera is positioned at eye level, capturing the figure in a medium close-up that emphasizes the facial expression and the texture of the wet clothing. The lighting is dim and diffused, with highlights on the wet surfaces creating a moody, atmospheric effect. There is no visible text in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A stylized, digitally rendered animal head with cyan-blue fur, red eyes, and a pink nose, set against a solid black background. The creature has large, upright ears with inner pinkish-red linings and a short, straight bang of cyan-blue hair. Its mouth is open, revealing sharp teeth and a dripping red substance resembling blood. The image features prominent digital glitch effects: horizontal red and cyan stripes and pixelated distortions overlay parts of the face and ears. The fur appears matte and textured like animal hair, while the red eyes are glossy and intense. The black background is flat and non-reflective. No visible text is present.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A figure with white, tousled hair and a dark, shadowy silhouette is partially submerged in turbulent, deep blue ocean water, their right arm extended forward with fingers splayed as if reaching or grasping. The figure wears a dark green, matte-textured jacket and dark pants, with the fabric appearing wet and clinging to their form. The water around them churns into frothy white foam, contrasting sharply with the deep blue of the surrounding sea. The camera angle is from above, looking down at the figure as they are caught in the crest of a wave, creating a dynamic, immersive perspective. The lighting is dim and cool, with a bright, almost glowing illumination highlighting the white hair and the white foam, casting the rest of the figure and the water into deep shadow. There is no visible text in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A pink feline humanoid with white facial markings and yellow eyes, wearing a tan trench coat with a matte fabric texture, extends a hand with a glossy pink skin tone and black nail polish to display a middle finger gesture. The background is dark and textured with scattered golden specks, suggesting a gritty or chaotic environment. The composition is a tight close-up, angled slightly from below, emphasizing the character’s confrontational expression and the gesture. Lighting is dramatic, casting sharp shadows and highlighting the glossy sheen on the skin and the matte surface of the coat. No visible text is present.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A giant inflatable toy shaped like a leopard’s paws and tail rests on a sandy beach, its glossy yellow and black spotted surface reflecting sunlight. The paws are oversized, with glossy black pads and cream-colored soles, and the tail extends forward with alternating black and yellow stripes. In the background, a turquoise ocean meets a clear blue sky with scattered white clouds, and a palm tree leans toward the right. A small red-and-white umbrella is visible near the shoreline, and rocky terrain appears on the left. The camera is positioned low, looking up at the paws, emphasizing their scale against the bright, sunlit beach. The sand is light beige and textured, and the inflatable’s surface is smooth and shiny, catching the direct sunlight. No visible text is present.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A large anthropomorphic tiger with orange and black striped fur, wearing a white cap with a green emblem, a black and yellow vest over a white shirt, and white pants with black straps, stands with arms crossed. Beside him, a smaller anthropomorphic fox with similar orange and black fur, also wearing a white cap with a green emblem, a black and yellow vest, and white pants, holds a Poké Ball. Both have sharp claws and wear black gloves. The larger tiger’s tail is long and bushy with orange and black stripes, and the smaller fox’s tail is shorter and fluffy. A Poké Ball floats above the larger tiger’s head. The background is plain white. The composition is a full-body shot from a slightly low angle, emphasizing the figures’ stature. Lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows beneath the feet. The cap’s emblem is a green stylized leaf. The cap is glossy plastic, the vest is matte fabric, the pants are matte fabric, the gloves are matte leather, the Poké Ball is glossy plastic with red and white sections, and the claws are matte skin.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A chibi-style anthropomorphic canine character with orange fur, black-tipped ears, and a fluffy orange tail with black spots stands against a plain white background. The character has one large blue eye visible and the other eye is closed, with tears streaming down their face and droplets floating around their head. They wear a white short-sleeved t-shirt with a small blue emblem on the chest and orange underwear with white trim. Their fur appears soft and fluffy, with a matte finish, while the t-shirt has a smooth, slightly wrinkled fabric texture. The character’s paws are large with white claws, and their tail curls upward. The composition is centered with the character facing slightly to the side, viewed from a straight-on perspective. The lighting is bright and even, casting a soft shadow beneath their feet. No visible text is present in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A grey-furred anthropomorphic wolf with pointed ears and a black headband is falling through the sky, mouth open in a shout, arms and legs spread wide. The wolf wears a white shirt with orange trim, black pants with orange stripes, and black-and-white sneakers; its wrists are bound with brown leather straps. The background is a bright blue sky with fluffy white clouds and a large, glowing yellow sun positioned above the wolf. The composition is dynamic, viewed from a low angle looking up at the falling figure, emphasizing motion. The lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows on the wolf’s fur, which has a matte texture. The clouds are voluminous and white, with subtle shading to suggest depth. No text is visible in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A feline humanoid with light beige fur and dark brown spots, wearing a glossy black bikini with straps and a matching choker, is partially submerged in a large, curling wave. Her long, wavy white hair, appearing glossy and voluminous, flows upward and outward around her head, catching the light. The wave itself is a deep teal with frothy white crests, and the background shows a bright, hazy sky with the sun shining through clouds, casting a warm glow. The camera angle is low, looking up at the figure as she emerges from the water, with the wave arching over her head. The water’s surface is glossy and reflective, with small bubbles visible near the bottom. The lighting is bright and directional, highlighting the contours of her face and the texture of her fur, which appears soft and slightly wet. There is no visible text in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A feline humanoid with spotted tan fur and dark brown spots, wearing a black headband with a gold circular emblem, crouches low to the ground. Its fur is fluffy and light brown around the head, with small rounded ears and amber eyes. The creature wears a red cloth draped over its shoulder and back, black wristbands with silver metallic patches, and a white cloth tied around its waist under a dark brown sash. Its long, curved tail, matching its spotted fur, curls upward with a fluffy white tip. The background is a plain, light gray surface with soft shadows beneath the figure. The lighting is soft and diffused, casting gentle highlights on the fur and metallic surfaces. The composition is a medium close-up, angled slightly from the front, emphasizing the creature’s intense gaze and crouched posture. No visible text is present.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A humanoid figure with feline features stands in profile against a plain, off-white background. The figure has short, dark brown hair with lighter tan highlights, large amber eyes with black pupils, and pointed ears with light tan inner surfaces and dark brown outer edges. The body is covered in smooth, light tan fur with darker brown patches on the tail and ears, and the skin beneath the fur appears pale and matte. The figure’s tail curves around the back, ending in a dark brown tip, and the arms are positioned with hands clasped loosely in front. The lighting is soft and even, casting gentle shadows that define the form without harsh contrasts. There is no visible text or watermark in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A pink-scaled, humanoid dragon with spiky dorsal fins and a long, curved tail is perched atop a rough, brown tree stump, arms raised in a triumphant pose, claws gripping the air. Its skin is glossy, pale pink with darker pink scales along its spine and tail, and it has large, pointed ears and sharp teeth visible in an open mouth. The background features a vast, clear blue sky with a few wispy white clouds and distant green mountain ranges covered in dark green coniferous trees. The camera is positioned low, looking up at the dragon, emphasizing its imposing stature against the expansive sky. Bright, direct sunlight illuminates the scene, casting sharp shadows and highlighting the glossy texture of the dragon’s scales and the rough, weathered surface of the stump. In the bottom right corner, the text “@MizturusAr” is visible in white.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A muscular humanoid figure with a red, reptilian face and textured, glossy red and black skin crouches, gripping a black rifle with a matte finish and a scope. The figure’s hands, covered in dark gloves, hold the weapon steady as it aims forward, its body angled low to the ground. Behind it, a forest backdrop features tall, dark tree trunks and a sky painted in shades of blue and white, with splashes of red paint streaking across the scene. The composition is tight, focusing on the figure’s upper body and weapon, viewed from a low angle that emphasizes its readiness. The lighting is dramatic, casting sharp shadows and highlighting the glossy sheen on the figure’s skin and the matte surface of the rifle. No visible text appears in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A glossy black, cat-eared humanoid figure with a smooth, reflective surface lies supine on a matching black, padded restraint board. The figure’s arms are raised above its head, hands clenched into claw-like fists, and its legs are spread apart with feet flat on the board, secured by black straps around the ankles and wrists. The head features pointed ears, large round eyes, and a small nose, all rendered in the same glossy black material. The restraint board is rectangular, with visible metal hinges at the top and bottom edges, and its surface is wrinkled and creased from the figure’s weight. The background is a plain, light-colored wall, with bright sunlight casting sharp shadows from the figure onto the board and wall. The lighting is direct and high-contrast, creating strong highlights on the glossy black surface and deep shadows in the crevices. No text is visible in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A pair of transparent, glossy, boot-like footwear with clawed toes rests on a dark, draped fabric surface. The boots are made of a clear, glass-like material with a smooth, reflective surface that catches and bends light, revealing internal contours and casting soft highlights. Each boot has five pointed, white claws at the toes, with a thin blue band visible along the bottom edge. The background is a solid black fabric with gentle folds and shadows, creating a stark contrast that emphasizes the boots’ translucency. The camera is positioned at a low angle, slightly elevated, capturing the boots from the front and side to show their three-dimensional form. The lighting is soft and directional, illuminating the boots from the front and side, enhancing their glossy texture and creating subtle reflections on the fabric beneath. There is a small, white, diamond-shaped watermark in the bottom right corner.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A stylized anthropomorphic wolf with light blue and white fur, sharp pointed ears, and amber eyes is depicted in a dynamic, crouching pose against a plain gray background. The wolf wears a dark gray, open coat with a white fur collar, revealing a white t-shirt with a yellow paw print emblem, dark gray pants with a white belt, and black boots. Its right paw is raised with claws extended, and its left paw is clenched into a fist, conveying aggression. A small blue pendant hangs from a black collar around its neck. The wolf’s tail, matching its fur, curls behind it. The lighting is even and flat, casting soft shadows that define the form without dramatic contrast. The coat’s fabric appears matte, the t-shirt is smooth, and the belt buckle is metallic. No visible text or logos are present.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A chibi-style anthropomorphic cat with white spiky hair and dark gray ears and muzzle, wearing a white collared shirt with a small blue square patch on the left chest and black pants, stands against a plain white background with a light blue square behind its torso; the cat has yellow eyes, a small pink X-shaped mark on its nose, and a subtle smile, with its tail curled behind it; the hair is matte and textured, the shirt appears to be made of cloth, the pants are matte and solid black, and the blue square behind is a flat matte surface; the lighting is even and bright, casting a soft shadow beneath the figure, suggesting a studio-like setup with no visible text or markings.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A humanoid figure with white fur, long white hair, and pointed ears is seated against a dark grey stone wall, bound by black metal chains that loop around her wrists and upper arms. She wears a black mask covering her nose and mouth, revealing only her red eyes, and a black scale-patterned bra and matching thigh-high boots with black leather straps. Her tail, pinkish in hue, curls near her feet beside two human skulls, one on each side. The background consists of rough-hewn grey stone blocks, with additional chains hanging from above. The lighting is dramatic, casting shadows that emphasize the glossy black of her attire and the matte texture of the stone. The composition is frontal, capturing her from the waist up, with her hands clasped above her head. No visible text is present.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A muscular anthropomorphic cat with brown fur, pointed ears, and a bushy tail is depicted in a dynamic, seated pose, one arm raised to grip the top of his head while sweat beads glisten across his skin and athletic attire. He wears a white basketball jersey with yellow trim and the word "HONNARU" in dark blue lettering above a large blue number "8" outlined in yellow, paired with white shorts featuring yellow and dark blue stripes along the sides. Over his shoulders rests a navy blue jacket with a light blue inner lining, partially open. His footwear consists of white sneakers with black accents and laces. The background is a plain, bright white, isolating the figure and emphasizing the contrast with his dark clothing and skin tone. The lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows that define his musculature and the folds of his clothing. The jersey's fabric appears smooth and slightly glossy, while his skin has a matte finish. The visible text on the jersey reads "HONNARU" in dark blue and "8" in blue with a yellow outline.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A wolf-like humanoid with white, fluffy fur and blue eyes, wearing segmented silver-grey armor with black straps and a mesh undergarment, crouches amidst rubble. The creature’s right hand grips a long, dark blade with a metallic sheen, while its left hand rests on the ground, revealing black, clawed fingers. Its fur is thick and voluminous, especially around the neck and tail, which trails behind. The background consists of broken stone structures with classical columns, partially obscured by brownish-orange smudges suggesting dust or blood. The composition is a low-angle shot, emphasizing the figure’s imposing posture and the chaotic environment. Lighting is dramatic, casting sharp shadows and highlighting the metallic sheen of the armor and the glossy finish of the blade. No visible text is present.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A muscular anthropomorphic tiger with purple and white striped fur, yellow eyes, and a dark muzzle stands in a dynamic pose, arms raised with claws extended. His torso is bare, revealing defined muscles and a purple star-shaped marking on his abdomen, while his arms and legs are clad in black and gold segmented armor with brown leather straps and buckles. He wears black shorts with a gold waistband and black boots with gold trim and lacing, and a long purple tail with black stripes trails behind him. The background is a muted, abstract blend of gray and beige tones, suggesting a cloudy or dusty environment. The lighting is directional, casting strong shadows and highlighting the glossy sheen of his fur and the matte texture of his armor. No visible text is present.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A humanoid anthropomorphic wolf with dark grey fur, pointed ears, and blue eyes is depicted kneeling, facing forward with arms raised and hands open. The character has a muscular torso with defined abdominal muscles, and a light pinkish-red nipple is visible. The character wears a partially open blue and white robe with a wave pattern on the lower hem, revealing a white loincloth and dark grey fur-covered legs ending in paws with white claws. The background is plain white, isolating the figure. The lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows beneath the arms and legs, highlighting the glossy sheen of the skin and the matte texture of the fur. The robe’s fabric appears smooth and slightly reflective, while the loincloth is translucent and sheer. No visible text is present.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A stylized anthropomorphic fox with dark purple fur, white muzzle, chest, and inner ears, and bright blue eyes, kneels in a dynamic pose against a plain white background. The character has pointed ears, a bushy tail with dark purple fur and white tips, and sharp claws on its hands and feet. Its torso is bare, revealing a muscular physique with a glossy white skin tone, and it wears a partially draped blue and white garment resembling a kimono with a scalloped white pattern along the edges, made of cloth. The garment is open at the front, exposing the character’s lower body, which is covered by a white loincloth with a glossy sheen and a small reddish-orange detail near the groin. The character’s right hand is raised with fingers curled, while the left hand rests on the ground, both hands showing dark purple fur and sharp claws. The lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows that define the character’s form and the folds of the garment. There is no visible text in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A humanoid figure with greenish-yellow fur, pointed ears, and green eyes stands in a dynamic pose, holding a longsword in their right hand and gesturing with their left. Their attire consists of a layered, teal-green robe with brown and white geometric patterns, a brown belt with a white eye-shaped buckle, and brown leggings. The robe’s fabric appears woven and textured, with fringed edges, while the belt is leather-like. They wear white gloves with greenish-yellow fur trim, brown arm bracers, and brown boots with greenish-yellow soles. Behind them, a faint white circular halo is visible. The background is an abstract, watercolor wash of pink, orange, and beige tones, suggesting falling leaves or petals, with sparse, thin brown branches. The ground is a mix of white, gray, and brown brushstrokes, resembling snow or dry earth. The lighting is soft and diffused, casting gentle shadows and highlighting the figure’s fur and clothing. No visible text is present.
</CAPTION>
